items.difficulty_reason: 37 行、有限个 Frobenius 拓扑生成 π₁：反设 Γ 真，取对应 Galois 覆盖 Y→X；选点集含各次数点 ⇒ 次数映射满 ⇒ Y_k̄ 不可约；次数 ≤N 的点全分裂 ⇒ 点数不等式；双侧 RH 界 + Riemann-Hurwitz 强迫 G 平凡。承重全在 span 内；无外部引用。

primary.label: author proposition environment with its own label proposition-finite-set-frobenii-generate-topologically (no canonical tag in the snapshot tag list); statement at source lines 4150-4155

proof_spans.label: the author's own proof environment immediately following the proposition: take all closed points of degree at most N, suppose the normal subgroup they generate is proper, pass to the corresponding Galois cover where all these points split completely, and use the Riemann hypothesis bounds on both sides plus the Riemann-Hurwitz formula to force the Galois group trivial for large N (source lines 4164-4200)
